required.description: Prop names that must be supplied by a consumer (e.g. a CMS) for the component to render meaningfully.

oneOf.description: Union type, e.g. ["string", "boolean"] for a prop that accepts either a message or a flag.

options.description: Either an enum of selectable values (type: "select") or a list of data option objects (e.g. { value, label }).

items.description: Shape of each entry, when type is "array".

properties.description: Named sub-fields, when type is "object". When "component" is also set, these are overrides/additions applied on top of the referenced component's own props (looked up by name), not a full copy of its shape.

component.description: Name of another component whose top-level contract entry defines this prop's shape (or each array item's shape, when type is "array"). This is a reference only — resolve it by looking up that component's own entry elsewhere in the manifest; it is not inlined here, to avoid duplication and circular-reference expansion. Combine with "omit"/"properties" to exclude or override individual fields on the referenced shape.

omit.description: Prop names to exclude from the referenced component's props. Only meaningful when "component" is set.
